lines: Behind Gosha Academy stretched a lush, green mountain forest.
And in this place, which was also used as a combat training ground for the academy, a battle to decide fate was about to begin.
Igawa Sakura
Looks like the time has finally come, Fuma-kun. Between you and I, who's gonna survive...?
Sakura was clad in her Taima-Suit, and a calm fighting spirit was emanating from her.
Me
To be honest, I didn't want to fight against you.
The situation was on a hair trigger. A tension unbefitting this invigorating forest was stretched tightly between me and Sakura.
Sakura
Don't say that, Fuma-kun. I mean, the same goes for meー
Sakura
I don't feel any resentment toward you. On the contrary, I'm grateful. I hoped we'd always be friends... but that wasn't in the cards.
Me
The so-called fate of the shinobi, huh? It's tough...
Even if they cared for each other, they sometimes had to fight to the death. That was the sad "fate" of the shinobi.
Everything had started withー
Late at night two days ago.

In Sakura's room at the Fuma residenceー
that is to say, at my home...
The young Sakura, who had come from a different dimension and wasn't able to return, was staying here as a freeloader.
How could she return to her dimension? She still didn't have any leads, but she also didn't seem to be thinking about it particularly seriously.
More so than that, she would ratherー
Sakura
YEAHHHHHH!! Head shot!!
Sakura
Did you see that, Fuma-kun!? Did you see my amazing play!? YES!! YEEEEESSSSSS!!!
Sakura's voice echoed through the room in the middle of the night. She was super excited and swung her controller in the air.
Me
H-Hey, I know there's nobody around, but try not to make such a racket!!
Sakura was currently hooked on numerous games that I had bought with my money, which I had saved up from my New Year's and regular allowances.
I wasn't sure about the detailed workings of it all, but it seemed like the dimension that Sakura was from was slightly in the past compared to this dimension.
In other words, all of my games were quite literally "next generation" for her.
Sakura
Wooooow, this really is amazing! The point of view moves when I just slightly tilt the controller!! And the graphics are unbelievable! Like a photo!!
Me
Hey, there are still three more enemies!! Don't let your guard down! I'm gonna flank them!
Sakura
Roger that, Captain!!
And in gaining a decent playing partner, my gaming fever had been rekindled as well. Sakura and I were both obsessed.
Me
Alright, Sakura, you take the... No! If you shoot now they'll return fire...
Sakura
Ah~ wait!! No!! Ouch!! Oh crap!! Fuma-kun, no!!
Me
Hold on!! I'm coming for you!!
Sakura
Yeah, hurry up!! Ah~ you're good! Fuma-kun, you're awesome!!
Me
Good, now to attack them from behind! You go too! Now!
Sakura
Yeah, yeah! Going, going, going! ...YES!! ALRIIIIIIIIGHT!!
Both of Us
YEEEEEESSSS!!
Satisfied with our superb result, we high fived.
Sakura
Man~! That was great!! Fuma-kun, how come you're so good at this!?
Me
Hehehe, because I practice every day!
Sakura
I see~ Will I also get better if I practice?
Me
Of course you will. Want to play one more round? I'll join you.
Sakura
Really? Even though it's already this late?
As I looked in the direction that Sakura was pointing, the clock was already showing 3:30.
Which of course meant 3:30 in the middle of the night. Tomorrow was... unfortunately not a day off, meaning I would have to go to school as usual, and normally would have gone to sleep long ago.
Me
It'll be fine. I can just sleep during class.
Sakura
Fuma-kun, you're such a delinquent...
Me
What? Do you want to stop then?
Sakura
Ehehe. No, I don't~♪
Me
Right?
I pressed the "continue" button again. That's right, there was nothing stopping the two of us today.
Me
Normally, we can't even fully enjoy games because Tokiko is always nagging us. I'm sure it's fine to go just a little overboard.
Me
Tokiko is out of town on a business trip... This is not a chance you get very often.
Sakura
Tokiko-san is always so strict~ Saying stuff like "Only one hour of gaming per day!"
Me
I know, right. God damn, she is just so stubbornー
Fuma Tokiko
My deepest apologies, Master. I returned one day earlier than scheduled.
Me
Sakura
A shudder ran through the totally still air of the room.

As we turned around in horrorー
Tokiko's cold eyes were looking down upon us.
Both of Us
GYAAAAAAAAAAAAA~!!?
Me
(Sheesh... that was ridiculously terrifying.)
After that, she had us sit kneeling for three hours until morning, and we received a scolding. We also had to promise to undergo a certain special training.

And that training wasー
competition-style covert training here in the forest behind the academy.
Tokiko
As you both know, beyond this point is an area for covert training with sophisticated traps set at all over.
Tokiko
To make it through, you will need not only your physical abilities, but also in-depth knowledge and observational skillsー
Tokiko
And whoever makes it through and arrives at the checkpoint first is the winner.
Me
H-Hold on. If I'm not mistaken, isn't this the advanced area where even professional Taimanin train and where people regularly get injured during trainingー
Tokiko
Correct.
Tokiko smiled broadly.
Tokiko
I thought this level of stimulation was necessary to whip your self-awareness as a Taimanin into shape, since it's completely languid.
Me
Ugh...
Tokiko
You are free to interfere with your opponent. How you use your supporters is also fully up to you. However, reaching the goal is something you yourself must do.
We had been told that we could call two supporters each, so a total of four supporters were already standing at the ready inside the course.
Tokiko
Both of you, are you ready?
Sakura
Yes, Tokiko-san! Any time is good!
Me
Yeah... me too.
It was finally time. Our tension escalated.
Sakura
Sorry, Fuma-kun, but... I will claim the right to receive an allowance!
Me
Hmph, just try and take it if you can!!
Yes, this was the reason why it was a "No-Backdown Battle"ー
The winner would get the right to receive an allowance.
Right now, Sakura's allowance was scraped together from my allowance.
Apparently Tokiko helped her out sometimes, but basically, as the one who had brought in the stray, it was my responsibility to watch and take care of her.
Me
(If the right to the allowance goes to Sakura... that would mean it would be like I was the pet dog! I definitely can't let that happen!)
This was a matter of life and death. Games and snacks alike... everything requires money.
Sakura
Hehe...
Me
(Shit!! What a sinister look Sakura has in her eyes!!)
All kinds of desires were swirling around in those eyes, from Inageya's ice cream, to cute clothes and new games...
Me
(I-I have to win no matter what...)
Me
(I should have a chance. I can't win in physical ability, but knowledge and observational skills will also be important in covert training.)
Me

(But if things don't go my way, then I have no choice. When that time comes, I'll have to use any means necessaryー
No hard feelings, Sakura.)
Tokiko
ーThen let the training begin!!
Hearing Tokiko's signal, we started running deeper into the forest.
